card.name: Drug names in interaction passages
card.fires_on: The final piece of a drug name (metformin, zolpidem, acetaminophen, aminoglycosides) when two drugs are discussed together, and the word 'additive' before 'effects' in interaction text.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about combining or joint action, and away from 'against' and 'appended'.
card.plain: It lights up near the end of a drug's name, or on 'additive', when the text is about two drugs used together.
